zh.title: 新功能
items: **新增 Qoder 模型供应商**：可接入 Qoder 私有供应商，模型目录在聊天菜单里展开为「供应商 → 模型」的悬浮父子菜单，未配置密钥的模型自动置灰；设置页的模型增删改不受影响。
**模型与思考模式随会话绑定并持久化**：每个会话各自记住所选模型与思考强度，切换会话或重启后自动恢复；首选模型失效时回退到默认，不会中断对话。

zh.title: 优化
items: 处理「安装 / 配置 / 管理 MCP」类请求更准确：助手会优先识别自己就是 MCP host 并查看自身注册表，而不是先去扫描外部客户端配置。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复连接在传输中途恢复时，「正在重试连接」横幅一直残留不消失的问题。
修复 Goal 模式下纯问答结束后，仍残留「执行中 0/1」目标契约的问题。
修复侧边栏删除确认的冗余「确认？」文字，并修正确认按钮垂直错位。

en.title: What's New
items: **Qoder model provider**: Connect Qoder private providers; the chat model menu expands as provider → model hover submenus, and models without keys are grayed out. Settings add/edit/remove is unchanged.

**Model & thinking mode bound per session**: Each session remembers its model and thinking strength across switches and restarts; if the preferred model is invalid it falls back without breaking the chat.

en.title: Improvements
items: MCP install/configure/manage requests are handled more accurately: the assistant recognizes it is itself an MCP host and checks its own registry first instead of scanning external client configs.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed the “retrying connection” banner sticking after a mid-transport recovery.
Fixed pure Q&A in Goal mode leaving a leftover “running 0/1” goal contract.
Removed redundant “Confirm?” copy on sidebar delete confirms and fixed vertical button misalignment.
